title: One phone format
prompt: The phone directory needs every number written the same way, like `555-201-3344`. Write `solve(employees)` so it returns `employee_id` and `phone`, with each phone number in that format.
rules: Phone numbers arrive with dashes, dots, spaces, brackets, a leading `+1`, or as ten digits in a row.
Keep the last ten digits and write them as three digits, a dash, three digits, a dash, four digits.
A missing phone stays missing. Return one row per employee, with only `employee_id` and `phone`.
hints: Start by removing everything that isn't a digit: `F.regexp_replace("phone", "[^0-9]", "")`.
`F.substring(digits, -10, 10)` keeps the last ten digits, which drops a country code in front.
Rebuild the format with three groups: `r"(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{4})"` and `$1-$2-$3`. Name the result `phone` with `alias`.
